summary: Baozun Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (Stock Code 09991) and Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for the month ended October 31, 2026. The exhibit reports only movements in authorized share capital and issued shares across weighted voting rights ordinary shares (Class A and Class B), with balances unchanged at 470,000,000 and 30,000,000 authorized shares respectively. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine HKEX monthly share-capital return, not a special situation.
